nom: Click&Collect has arrived to Parque Warner
description: service arrives at Parque Warner Madrid, with which you can book your menu before going to eat. What are the advantages? You can order your menu when you want in the restaurant of your choice, without waiting! Enjoy the Park to the fullest and save waiting time! Step 1: Access the Click&Collect website. Select the hour you would like to pick up your meal.

The best place to get your strength back in the Old West Territory Take a break in our 100% vegan point. Get your energy back with our healthy and balanced way with our wide range of products, choose between hot dogs, hamburgers, nachos or salads. Come and try it in the Old West Territory area!

The best XXL food you can find in the Wild West! The bandits from the Old West Territory have fled from Parque Warner Madrid, and they’ve done so for good reason. They heard talk of a dangerous and fast gunslinger, so they jumped on their horses and headed for the hills. Now they are looking for new ways to rob any unfortunate people they encounter.

At this kiosk in the heart of Gotham City, you can enjoy some of the delicacies that exist in the world's darkest city. Take a ride on the Batman: Gotham City Escape attraction and, on the way out, get your food at the Robinson Park Pantry. Don't forget to try the star product, the Batgofre, which will make you feel like a real hero or villain.

Enjoy a wide range of different homemade pastries on Hollywood Boulevard Located on Hollywood Boulevard, Beverly Hills Bakery is one of those special places that you can only find at Parque Warner. Its extraordinary façade captivates all our visitors, even more so at night. Try our famous Iberian ham sandwich with natural tomato and enjoy a huge selection of homemade pastries.

Authentic food for cowboys in the Old West Territory You’ve just gotten off the stagecoach and you’re feeling some midday fatigue. You’re hungry and the journey has been long and rough: the Old West Territory is not a peaceful place and there are dangers around every corner.

The best XXL food you can find in the Wild West! The bandits from the Old West Territory have fled from Parque Warner Madrid, and they’ve done so for good reason. They heard talk of a dangerous and fast gunslinger, so they jumped on their horses and headed for the hills. Now they are looking for new ways to rob any unfortunate people they encounter.

The best frozen yogurt with the most natural toppings Enjoy llaollao frozen yogurt and live the most natural experience with the most delicious toppings, all the sauces you can imagine, the freshest fruit and, of course, the most nutritious and refreshing frozen yogurt.
Try our irresistible artisanal ice creams right in the heart of Gotham City The Penguin is a tough villain, and you’ll find it hard to give him the slip in DC Super Heroes World.

Try the food enjoyed by the most intrepid journalists If you manage to sneak into the Daily Planet editorial office you will have the privilege of tasting our wide range of homemade pizzas and of course don't forget our famous salchipapas and our exclusive waffles and crepes.

An authentic Western Saloon for cowboys to get their strength back Riding towards the horizon, without rest, feeling like this journey is never going to end… You’re in the Wild West, and you feel like taking a break after a day of riding incredible attractions like the Coaster-Express rollercoaster and traversing desolate canyons and valleys.
Try our incredible freshly-made sandwiches at Movie World Studios Jack’s Fish Market is located in Movie World Studios, very close to Stunt Fall (the most spectacular rollercoaster at Parque Warner).

The sweetest stop during your visit to Cartoon Village Helados Vaca y Pollo is located right in the middle of Cartoon Village, and it’ll be the sweetest stop during your visit to Parque Warner. You can enjoy waffles with cream, a wide range of delicious ice cream cones, super refreshing slushies and much more.

An unbeatable selection of hot dogs at the best price on Hollywood Boulevard You’ll find us on Hollywood Boulevard, at Parque Warner. The perfect way to begin or end your trip through the park is with a stop at our classic restaurant: Hollywood Hot Dogs. The name says it all: how would you like to try one of our unbeatable range of hot dogs?

Enjoy the best Ben & Jerry’s ice creams in Metropolis You will find Empire in the middle of the city of Metropolis in DC Superheroes World, an ideal place for real superheroes to refuel with the best Ben & Jerry’s ice creams. They’re delicious! You can also choose from a wide range of pastries and coffees specially designed for the occasion.

Take a break to get your energy back at Cartoon Village Take a break to get your energy back at Cartoon Village before you continue your adventure. TNT Coffee is the perfect place for the little ones to get their strength back without missing out on one minute of fun. They can choose from a wide variety of sandwiches to suit all tastes.

La Casa del Sol is a buffet restaurant located opposite the Police Academy, next to the lake. There you will find the best selection of Mediterranean cuisine. Choose from rice, pasta, salads, meat, fish, side dishes and a variety of desserts to satisfy your appetite.

Enjoy the food fit for true superstars at our à la carte restaurant Hollywood Boulevard at Parque Warner is inspired by the glamour of the magical movie industry, so it is the perfect home for Foster's Hollywood, where you can taste the flavours of American food: burgers, ribs and more.

Our most lively self-service restaurant for the little ones in Cartoon Village If you’ve just visited El Camerino de Pato Lucas, before you continue you should get your strength back at our most entertaining self-service restaurant. Come and enjoy our incredible Mediterranean salad, our irresistible Italian pasta or one of our unbeatable rice dishes from the Looney Tunes.

Come and enjoy the best grilled beef burgers with Porky. They’re delicious! A relaxed, colourful and friendly environment in the style of a classic American diner, this is what it’s like every dat at Porky Pig Diner, in Parque Warner Madrid, a restaurant themed after Porky Pig himself. This laid-back stammering little pig starred in the Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies.

Enjoy the best food the world has to offer at this buffet in a movie studio You will find the best food in the world at this buffet, located in the Movie World Studios area, in the amazing setting of a real movie studio. All year long we offer various different menus that change according to the seasons.

Enjoy delicious Italian food right in the middle of Cartoon Village This restaurant in Cartoon Village has a charming sign on top of it with Tweety dressed as a gondolier, and it offers the best pizzas baked to order and our vegetable focaccia, which you can enjoy while relaxing on the large terrace. Or if you’d prefer, we also offerhot dogs, in regular or XXL size.

A rest stop right in the middle of the movie set on our New York street At Movie World Studios, right in the middle of the movie set on our New York street, we recommend you take a break and try our fantastic sandwiches with Iberian ham and pork loin, which comes with the Navidul guarantee, and don’t forget to accompany it with something from our fantastic range of pastries.

Enjoy a sweeter version of the Wild West. That’s what you’ll find here, partner. At our ice cream shop to the south of the Old West Territory you can enjoy loads of different ice creams and delicious slushies. It’s the perfect place to stop by after lunch at El Rancho, or after an exhilarating ride on the barges at Río Bravo.

Coffee lovers are in luck because they can enjoy all the very best renowned Starbucks products at our park. It is the perfect excuse to take a break from your visit to Parque Warner and taste one of the best coffees, luxury teas, delicious pastries and other tasty options to please your palate. But don’t take our word for it, come and try them for yourselves!

Even the bravest superheroes need to get their strength back sometimes. Located in SUPER HEROES WORLD, at Gotham City Grill you can recharge your batteries after LEX LUTHOR's madness: delicious grilled burgers, chicken or beef, whichever you prefer. We also offer tasty chicken pops and strips, Caesar salads, onion rings and hot dogs.

Are you visiting the park and have celiac disease? We’ve got great news… They say the fastest mouse in all of Mexico has stopped by to make his mark… Don Gonzales Taquería is a Mexican restaurant on Hollywood Boulevard, perfect for enjoying gluten-free Mexican food inside the park.
